ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity (white) to 20% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity medial zones; contiguous black pigmentation at distal tips; dense black mottling at the peduncle insertion point; sparse black focal spots (less than 15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the high-intensity field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression; calculated pixel angle of approximately 145 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 7% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixels) along the trailing edge; one distinct macro-indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave trajectory from the median notch to the tips; leading edges exhibit a convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters localized at the distal tips; scattered circular low-intensity spots on the lower medial quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the lower medial portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake marks crossing the pigmentation interface; distinct brownish/yellowish staining on the superior portions of the white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown hue shift (diatom film) on the upper-lateral regions of the white ventral surface.
